# Toronto Raptors 2026/27 NBA Season Preview: Kawhi Is Back!

Locked On Fantasy Basketball, 2026-08-20, 34:31. https://youtu.be/s28HvC2grAk

## Summary

Josh Leon and Sean Woodley of Locked On Raptors preview the 2026/27 Toronto Raptors. They assume the Kawhi Leonard trade (for Brandon Ingram, Gradey Dick and picks) goes through and that Kawhi is not suspended. The core is Quickley, Barrett, Leonard, Barnes and Poeltl, with Collin Murray-Boyles as a super sub who should close games. Expectations: Quickley takes the highest-volume three-point season of his career in an off-ball role, Barnes has his best season, and Poeltl's value depends on his back. Sean predicts 52 wins and says Kawhi plays about 60 to 65 games. Josh's main worries are Kawhi's injuries and load management, plus a thin bench after the top seven.
